rules.name: Chest Pain / Pressure
rules.reason: Possible acute coronary syndrome / myocardial infarction or pulmonary embolism.

rules.name: Severe Respiratory Distress
rules.reason: Severe respiratory compromise or anaphylaxis.

rules.name: Acute Neurological Deficit (Stroke Signs)
rules.reason: High suspicion for acute ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke.

rules.name: Anaphylaxis / Severe Allergic Reaction
rules.reason: Rapidly progressing systemic hypersensitivity reaction.

rules.name: Uncontrolled / Severe Bleeding
rules.reason: Risk of hemorrhagic shock or major arterial vascular injury.

rules.name: Suicidal Ideation / Crisis
rules.reason: Immediate risk of self-harm or suicide attempt.

rules.name: Severe Abdominal Pain
rules.reason: Potential abdominal catastrophe (viscus perforation, appendicitis perforation, dissecting AAA).

rules.name: High Fever with Stiff Neck
rules.reason: High concern for acute bacterial meningitis.

rules.name: Poisoning / Overdose
rules.reason: Acute toxic ingestion or drug toxicity.

rules.name: Loss of Consciousness
rules.reason: Unexplained loss of consciousness, risk of cardiac arrhythmia or seizure.

rules.name: Severe Head Trauma
rules.reason: Potential intracranial hemorrhage or traumatic brain injury.

rules.name: Sudden Vision Loss
rules.reason: Concern for retinal artery occlusion, retinal detachment, or temporal arteritis.

rules.name: Infant Fever (< 3 Months)
rules.reason: High risk of serious occult bacterial infection in neonates/young infants.

rules.name: Pregnancy with Severe Pain or Bleeding
rules.reason: Possible ectopic pregnancy, placental abruption, or miscarriage.

rules.name: High Fever > 39.4°C / Persistent 3+ Days
rules.reason: Potential systemic infection requiring prompt evaluation.

rules.name: Worsening Productive Cough
rules.reason: Possible lower respiratory tract infection / bronchitis / mild pneumonia.

rules.name: Mild Upper Respiratory Symptoms
rules.reason: Typical viral upper respiratory infection (common cold).

rules.name: Severe Dehydration
rules.reason: Severe fluid loss can cause shock, kidney injury, or dangerous electrolyte changes.

rules.name: Severe Hypoglycemia
rules.reason: Severe hypoglycemia can impair consciousness and cause seizures or death.

rules.name: Severe Hyperglycemia
rules.reason: Marked hyperglycemia may indicate diabetic ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar crisis.

rules.name: Sepsis Warning Signs
rules.reason: Possible severe infection with organ dysfunction requires immediate assessment.

rules.name: New Severe Palpitations
rules.reason: New palpitations with instability symptoms require prompt cardiac evaluation.

rules.name: Persistent Vomiting
rules.reason: Persistent vomiting can cause dehydration and may signal a serious underlying illness.

rules.name: Moderate Asthma Flare
rules.reason: Worsening airflow limitation may progress to respiratory distress.

rules.name: Urinary Infection Symptoms
rules.reason: Urinary symptoms should be evaluated to determine whether infection or another cause is present.

rules.name: Back Pain with Neurologic Deficit
rules.reason: Possible spinal cord or cauda equina compression requires immediate evaluation.

rules.name: Severe Eye Pain or Vision Change
rules.reason: Severe eye pain or acute visual change may threaten vision and needs prompt assessment.

rules.name: Sudden Severe Weakness
rules.reason: Sudden focal weakness may indicate stroke or another time-sensitive neurologic emergency.

rules.name: Leg Swelling with Breathlessness
keywords: leg swelling with shortness of breath
rules.reason: The combination may indicate a blood clot or pulmonary embolism and needs immediate assessment.

rules.name: Postpartum Heavy Bleeding
rules.reason: Heavy bleeding after delivery can rapidly become life-threatening.
